AI Notes.value: Independent British graphic designer and art director (Nash Projects), 10+ yrs experience. Educated at Nottingham Trent University (First Class Honours). Early career: North Kingdom (Stockholm), then Amore (Stockholm brand/packaging studio, now closed). Has operated Nash Projects independently since. Works across branding, identity, packaging, print, and art direction. Clients include HEAD Padel, A Day's March, T.H. Agyei, Late Nine, Arc Simulations, Synaptis. Nash's site lists Founderful as a client but Koto did a 2024 Founderful rebrand; Nash may have done an earlier identity pass. Confirmed freelance via site + Behance. Senior/mid-director level, solo operator; Autonomy 4. Work capture note: nash-projects.com runs on Cargo.site which blocks headless browser image loading entirely; project images captured from Behance (HEAD Padel gallery) and Buck case study (WeTransfer/Outernet). Instagram @nashprojects_archive is now unavailable (profile removed or set private); no active IG found.
